'''February 2001 Minneapolis tournament (6 February)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 6 February 2001. [[Timm Halverson]] won it. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1709">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-07-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1709/ mirkwood-deadbody-style], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 7 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-07-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1709/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Timm Halverson]]
